paper_record.title: Bright and Dark Excitons in CrSBr: Local Ligand-Field Character and Band-Coherent Optical Selection Rules
paper_record.abstract: Magnetic van der Waals semiconductors such as CrSBr host an intricate exciton landscape whose physical interpretation has converged only recently. A many-body Feynman diagrammatic approach based on quasiparticle self-consistent GW with electron-hole ladder vertex corrections to the screened Coulomb interaction has established the electronic band gap, excitonic orbital character, real-space extent, binding energies, and bosonic-coupling signatures of the bright XA exciton near 1.34 eV and the higher XB manifold near 1.8 eV. These results agree well with ARPES and magneto-optical experiments and supersede the early Rydberg-like assignment of the excitons. What has remained unresolved is why these intense bright excitons coexist, within a few tens of meV, with companion states that are several orders of magnitude darker despite drawing from essentially the same single-particle transition manifold. Here we show that brightness is a band-coherent property of the excitonic eigenfunctions: bright and dark partners are sublattice-symmetric and sublattice-antisymmetric superpositions of the same ligand-field-like Bloch transitions across the two Cr atoms of the orthorhombic primitive cell. The commonly used Frenkel and Wannier-Mott labels describe what an exciton is made of, but brightness requires a symmetry-adapted interference rule between transition dipoles. Disentangling this bare excitonic structure is a prerequisite for interpreting the optical response of CrSBr once magnon, phonon, and photon couplings are included.

one_sentence_summary.zh: 本文揭示了磁性范德华半导体CrSBr中明暗激子共存的物理机制，指出其亮度取决于子格对称性调控的能带相干光学干涉选择定则。
one_sentence_summary.en: This work reveals the physical mechanism behind the coexistence of bright and dark excitons in the magnetic van der Waals semiconductor CrSBr, showing that their brightness is determined by band-coherent optical interference selection rules governed by sublattice symmetry.

problem.zh: 解释为什么在CrSBr中，尽管源自几乎相同的单粒子跃迁流形，强烈的明激子与能量极接近但强度弱几个数量级的暗激子会共同存在。
problem.en: To explain why intense bright excitons in CrSBr coexist with near-degenerate companion states that are several orders of magnitude darker, despite drawing from nearly the same single-particle transition manifold.

approach.zh: 采用准粒子自洽GW结合阶梯顶点校正（QSGW与顶角校正）与Bethe-Salpeter方程（BSE）方法，解析激子本征态，并计算基于能带跃迁通道的相干光学干涉指数。
approach.en: Employ quasiparticle self-consistent GW with ladder vertex corrections (QSGW with vertex corrections) combined with the Bethe-Salpeter equation (BSE) to decompose excitonic eigenstates and calculate the coherent optical interference index based on band transition channels.

main_takeaway.zh: 激子的亮度是一种能带相干性质：明激子和暗激子分别是相同配体场Bloch跃迁在两个铬原子子格上的对称（相长干涉）和反对称（相消干涉）叠加。
main_takeaway.en: Excitonic brightness is a band-coherent property: bright and dark partners are sublattice-symmetric (constructive interference) and sublattice-antisymmetric (destructive interference) superpositions of the same ligand-field-like Bloch transitions across the two Cr atoms.

why_it_matters.zh: 它超越了传统的Frenkel和Wannier-Mott激子分类，为理解二维磁性半导体中的多体激子态提供了精确的理论基准，并解释了近期实验中观测到的暗激子信号。
why_it_matters.en: It transcends the conventional Frenkel and Wannier-Mott classifications, providing a precise theoretical baseline for understanding many-body excitonic states in 2D magnetic semiconductors and explaining dark exciton signals observed in recent experiments.

reason.zh: 澄清了CrSBr中明暗激子共存的物理起源，提出了基于子格对称性的相干干涉选择定则。
reason.en: It clarifies the physical origin of the coexistence of bright and dark excitons in CrSBr, proposing a coherent interference selection rule based on sublattice symmetry.

reason.zh: 该研究提出了关于二维磁性半导体激子选择定则的重要物理机制，非常适合发表在物理学顶级期刊上。
reason.en: The study proposes an important physical mechanism regarding exciton selection rules in 2D magnetic semiconductors, making it highly suitable for a top physics journal.
